After a thrilling F1 United States GP in Austin, Texas last weekend, Kimi Antonelli of Mercedes won, yet another (his ninth), race of the season with 365 points after 18 races. Ferrari’s Charles Leclerc came in second and Red Bull Racing’s Max Verstappen rounding out the podium. And now, for season’s is 19th round, F1 travels from Texas to Mexico City.
The F1 Mexico City Grand Prix takes place at Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez in Mexico City, Mexico. Practice 1 begins on Friday, Oct. 30, while race day lands on Sunday, Nov. 1.
